verhaeghe::what is the maximum employer.answer: For Bakkerij Verhaeghe, the maximum employer contribution for meal vouchers this year (2026) is EUR 6.91 per voucher (with a face value of EUR 8.00). Although they previously contributed EUR 5.91, the client transitioned to the maximum meal voucher scheme effective 1 January 2026 to remain competitive.

cla-verhaeghe-2025.claim: Bakkerij Verhaeghe transitioned to the maximum meal voucher scheme with an employer contribution of EUR 6.91 starting 1 January 2026.

ho-verhaeghe-2025.claim: As of May 2025, Bakkerij Verhaeghe provided meal vouchers with an employer contribution of EUR 5.91.

pol-mv-2026.claim: The maximum employer contribution for meal vouchers in Belgium for 2026 is EUR 6.91 per voucher.

pol-mv-2026-copy.claim: The maximum employer contribution for meal vouchers in Belgium is EUR 6.91.

pol-ecocheques-2025.claim: Eco vouchers in Belgium have a maximum value of EUR 250 per employee per year.

chat-mv-nl.claim: The maximum tax-free meal allowance from the employer in the Netherlands is EUR 8.00 per day.

verhaeghe::how many days of notice does.answer: For Bakkerij Verhaeghe, a fixed-term contract can be terminated early during the first half of the contract (and up to the first 6 months) using the notice period of an open-ended contract. Since the employee has two months of seniority (less than 3 months), the employer must give a notice period of 1 week. This notice must be given in writing and starts on the Monday following its notification.

pol-fixedterm-2026.claim: During the first half of a fixed-term contract (and up to the first 6 months), either party can terminate it early with the notice period of an open-ended contract, which is 1 week for the employer if seniority is under 3 months.

delcour::what is the maximum eco voucher.answer: For Delcour Logistics, the maximum eco voucher amount is EUR 250 per employee per year, in accordance with the general Belgian policy. This amount is exempt from social security and tax when granted by a collective labor agreement. The client-specific handover note does not specify any different amount or exception for eco vouchers.

pol-ecocheques-2025.claim: The maximum eco voucher amount in Belgium is EUR 250 per employee per year.
